objective: Build Focus Lens — Privacy Dashboard for productivity monitoring, with end-to-end encryption and granular data controls

steps.task: Define requirements: privacy dashboard showing data collection, retention policies, export options, and granular controls. Ensure zero-data-collection compliance.
Create wireframes: (1) overview dashboard with data categories, (2) detailed breakdown per data type, (3) export/delete actions, (4) privacy policy summary. Follow minimalist, trustworthy design.
Implement dashboard components: (1) category tiles with metrics, (2) filter/sort controls, (3) export to CSV/PDF, (4) data deletion workflow, (5) cookie/consent management.
Integrate end-to-end encryption for stored data, secure authentication (biometric/credentials), audit logs, and GDPR-compliant data handling.
Prepare production build, verify privacy features, and document compliance.
